title: AACTE Releases National Framework on Artificial Intelligence in Educator Preparation
body_markdown:
**Key Takeaways:**


- AACTE released a new AI Framework for Educator Preparation to help colleges and universities prepare future educators to use AI effectively and responsibly.
- The framework treats AI literacy as a professional teaching skill, emphasizing that educators need more than technical knowledge to make informed decisions about AI in the classroom.
- The framework focuses on four areas: ethical and policy guardrails, classroom implementation, cognitive impacts and advocacy, and professional expertise and human judgment.
- Human judgment remains central to AI use in education, with educators retaining responsibility for instructional decisions, student relationships, ethical reasoning, and culturally responsive teaching.
